void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClickMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClickMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClickMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClick;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClickMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClickMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClickMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClick;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDownMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDownMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDownMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDown;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUpMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUpMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUpMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUp;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDragMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler, vector drag);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDragMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDragMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDrag;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdateMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler, float value);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdateMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdateMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdate;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChangeMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler, vector position);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChangeMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChangeMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChange;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHoverMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHoverMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHoverMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHover;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHoverMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHoverMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHoverMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHover;

void RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorMethod(Widget widget, RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler handler);
typedef func RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorMethod;
typedef ScriptInvokerBase<RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorMethod> RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursor;

// Main widget for touch screen widgets
// Handle input from RHS_TouchScreenHandler
class RHS_TouchScreenWidgetHandler : ScriptedWidgetComponent
{
	protected Widget m_wRoot;

	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClick m_OnClick;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClick m_OnDoubleClick;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDown m_OnCursorDown;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUp m_OnCursorUp;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDrag m_OnCursorDrag;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdate m_OnWheelUpdate;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChange m_OnCursorPositionChange;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHover m_OnCursorHover;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHover m_OnCursorUnHover;
	protected ref RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursor m_OnCursorCursor;

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	override void HandlerAttached(Widget w)
	{
		m_wRoot = w;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Widget GetRootWidget()
	{
		return m_wRoot;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClick GetOnClick()
	{
		if (!m_OnClick)
			m_OnClick = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnClick();
		return m_OnClick;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClick GetOnDoubleClick()
	{
		if (!m_OnDoubleClick)
			m_OnDoubleClick = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnDoubleClick();
		return m_OnDoubleClick;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDown GetOnCursorDown()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorDown)
			m_OnCursorDown = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDown();
		return m_OnCursorDown;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUp GetOnCursorUp()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorUp)
			m_OnCursorUp = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorUp();
		return m_OnCursorUp;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDrag GetOnCursorDrag()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorDrag)
			m_OnCursorDrag = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorDrag();
		return m_OnCursorDrag;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdate GetOnWheelUpdate()
	{
		if (!m_OnWheelUpdate)
			m_OnWheelUpdate = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnWheelUpdate();
		return m_OnWheelUpdate;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHover GetOnHover()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorHover)
			m_OnCursorHover = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnHover();
		return m_OnCursorHover;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHover GetOnUnHover()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorUnHover)
			m_OnCursorUnHover = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnUnHover();
		return m_OnCursorUnHover;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChange GetOnCursorPositionChange()
	{
		if (!m_OnCursorPositionChange)
			m_OnCursorPositionChange = new RHS_ScriptInvokerTouchScreenOnCursorPositionChange();
		return m_OnCursorPositionChange;
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnWidgetUpdate(float timeSlice)
	{

	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnHover()
	{
		if (m_OnCursorHover)
			m_OnCursorHover.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnUnHover()
	{
		if (m_OnCursorUnHover)
			m_OnCursorUnHover.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorDown()
	{
		if (m_OnCursorDown)
			m_OnCursorDown.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorUp()
	{
		if (m_OnCursorUp)
			m_OnCursorUp.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorClick()
	{
		if (m_OnClick)
			m_OnClick.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorDoubleClick()
	{
		if (m_OnDoubleClick)
			m_OnDoubleClick.Invoke(m_wRoot, this);
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursor(vector cursor)
	{
		
	}

	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	bool OnWheelUpdate(float value)
	{
		if (m_OnWheelUpdate)
			m_OnWheelUpdate.Invoke(m_wRoot, this, value);
		return false;
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorPositionChange(vector cursorPosition)
	{
		if (m_OnCursorPositionChange)
			m_OnCursorPositionChange.Invoke(m_wRoot, this, cursorPosition);
	}
	
	//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void OnCursorDrag(vector cursorDrag)
	{
		if (m_OnCursorDrag)
			m_OnCursorDrag.Invoke(m_wRoot, this, cursorDrag);
	}
}
